title: Funding/Open-Interest Crowding-Reversal Research Template
hypothesis: An extreme venue-normalized funding state combined with elevated open interest and failed directional extension may precede a reversal against crowded perpetual positioning, net of costs.

required_data.field: venue funding rate, formula inputs, and payment timestamps
open interest by venue and aggregate coverage
required_data.freshness: aligned to each closed signal bar

long: Funding and basis meet the predeclared short-crowded extreme after venue normalization.
Open interest or the leverage ratio is elevated relative to its frozen rolling baseline.
Price fails to extend lower and closes back above the predeclared 15m confirmation level.
The entry is rejected if active deleveraging or a liquidity dislocation is still accelerating.
short: Funding and basis meet the predeclared long-crowded extreme after venue normalization.
Open interest or the leverage ratio is elevated relative to its frozen rolling baseline.
Price fails to extend higher and closes back below the predeclared 15m confirmation level.
The entry is rejected if active deleveraging or a liquidity dislocation is still accelerating.

invalidation: Price resumes the crowded-direction move beyond the structural and volatility invalidation level.
Funding or open-interest data is stale, revised, or incomparable across the selected venues.
The market enters an unresolved liquidation cascade or oracle dislocation.
exit_logic: Test exits at neutralized funding/basis, an opposing VWAP reference, or a frozen reward multiple.
Use a structural plus volatility stop and model gap-through fills.
Apply the maximum holding period and exact funding payments during the position.

cost_model.notes: Apply each venue's historical funding formula and timestamp; aggregate signals only after documenting coverage and avoiding future revisions.

rules: Use caller-supplied risk budget, current stop distance, depth, and liquidation buffer to determine size.
Do not treat extreme funding as permission to add against continuing price movement.
Disallow entry when venue-specific margin or oracle behavior cannot be reproduced.

failure_modes: Crowding can persist and become more extreme while price trends further.
Funding conventions differ across venues, so raw rates are not directly comparable.
Open-interest aggregates can mix contracts, double-count exposure, or revise history.
The apparent reversal is only a pause before forced deleveraging resumes.
validation_plan: Normalize funding to a common horizon while retaining each venue's actual cash-flow schedule.
Use point-in-time open-interest data and document venue additions, outages, and contract migrations.
Walk forward with frozen crowding thresholds and an untouched final period.
Report by direction, venue, funding quantile, positioning state, and after-cost expectancy with uncertainty.
warning: Untested research hypothesis. Not financial advice, a recommendation, or evidence of profitability.
